title: Health bar
prompt: A health bar at (0, 0) is max_width wide when health is full. Return the Rect2 to draw for the current hp: the same height, but only as wide as the fraction of health left.
signature: func solve(max_width: float, height: float, hp: float, max_hp: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(max_width: float, height: float, hp: float, max_hp: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(0, 0, max_width, height)
hint: The fraction is hp divided by max_hp. Multiply the full width by it.
solution:
func solve(max_width: float, height: float, hp: float, max_hp: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(0, 0, max_width * hp / max_hp, height)
